race.description: Crowne Real Estate Geoff Paulsen Mdn Plate
race.comment: ARISTOCRATIC GIRL (8) finds the maiden win elusive but is knocking on the door, with back-to-back placings to open the prep. Her fourth at Eagle Farm came in mid-week company on heavy ground and she now finds easier company third-up. Ready. ENGLISH CONQUEROR (1) shares a similar profile and is the main danger if ready fresh, having ended last campaign beaten a head at this venue and then trialled a close second at Ipswich. TEXAS (3) was favourite that day and finished fourth, so he has ground to make up, but his recent ratings keep him in the winning mix. GOULBURN (2) was much better in his second start when leading them up on the Poly. Drops back sharply in trip third-up but if he pushes forward again and gets his own way, he's a chance to steal it.
